description: Source code implementing ASN.1 structures and methods for private IE IDs and private IE fields in the XNAP protocol, including serialization, deserialization, and JSON conversion.

classes.name: private_ie_id_c
classes.description: Class representing a private IE ID with options for local or global types, including serialization and JSON conversion methods.

classes.name: private_ie_field_s
classes.description: Template class for private IE fields, handling packing, unpacking, and JSON serialization.

classes.name: private_ie_container_item_s
classes.description: Template class for private IE container items, managing serialization and JSON conversion.

methods.name: set
methods.description: Sets the type of private IE ID.

methods.name: set_local
methods.description: Sets the private IE ID to local type and returns reference to c.

methods.name: set_global
methods.description: Sets the private IE ID to global type.

methods.name: to_json
methods.description: Serializes the private IE ID to JSON.

methods.name: pack
methods.description: Serializes the private IE ID or field into bit buffer.

methods.name: unpack
methods.description: Deserializes the private IE ID or field from bit buffer.
